tools.name: search_assets
tools.description: Search the free CC0 library of 3D models, PBR textures and HDRIs by meaning and filters. Every model is a GLB measured in metres, +Y up, origin at the base. Check size_m before placing an asset; use min_size_m >= 2 for floors and walls. previews (max 6) attaches thumbnails, which is cheaper than dow

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Full details for one library asset: download URLs per format and resolution, size in metres, up axis and origin, texture maps, a credit line (credit, credit_html), related assets, and import notes for Godot, Unity, three.js and Blender. When you write credits or a README for a project using the asse

tools.name: generate_model
tools.description: Make one 3D object (never a scene) as a textured GLB, from a picture (image) or a description (prompt). Costs credits, which the user bought: image models trellis-2 5, trellis-2-pro 15, hunyuan-3d-3-1-pro 90, tripo-3-1 50, tripo-3-1-detailed 100; from a prompt add the picture model (flux-2-klein 1).

tools.name: edit_model
tools.description: Change a model you have: retexture (new PBR textures from a picture or words; trellis-2-texture 5, trellis-2-texture-pro 10, tripo-texture 20, tripo-texture-detailed 40 credits) or remesh (new, clean topology at a face count; tripo-remesh 50 credits). The mesh is an https URL, an upload id from uplo

tools.name: generate_texture
tools.description: A seamless PBR texture set (base colour, normal, height, roughness, metallic at 2048 px) from a description, for flux-2-klein-material 2, muse-image-material 5, gpt-image-2-5-material 8 credits.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Waits up to about 45 s for a job to finish, or reads where it stands. Safe to call again and again; never charges. When done: download URLs for every file, a preview picture, the model's size in metres and triangle count, and an asset id usable as input to the next step.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: The server cannot read the user's disk. This returns an upload id and the exact curl command that sends a local file (a mesh or picture) to it; run that command, then pass the id as the image or mesh of another tool. Uploads last 24 hours.

tools.name: account
tools.description: The credit balance, the price of every tool and model in credits (1 credit = $0.01), the rate limits and this key's daily spending cap. Check before spending.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_asset, get_job · Private data: edit_model, get_job, upload_file · Public sink: edit_model, upload_file · Destructive: get_asset, upload_file.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_asset, get_job · Private data: edit_model, get_job, upload_file · Public sink: edit_model, upload_file · Destructive: get_asset, upload_file

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
